leo_ae: Marigold wants a short POC of their 13B quant variant. Requirements: BYOK for trial, HSM later, p95 <20ms for 16-token replies, and a committed pricing ballpark. Can we run a compatibility probe this week?
emily_sales: Theyll start hosted for speed then move private. Main open items: security questionnaire + pricing for reserved nodes.
kai_ml: Ask them if the custom GELU is pure CUDA or fused into ops. Need TorchScript/ONNX + tokenizer to validate kernels.
marta_security: Hosted BYOK possible via KMS proxy with attestation; private supports direct HSM. We need key rotation policy and DFD. NDA required for SOC2/pentest docs.
nora_ops: For the trial we need a pre-approved fallback variant in the catalog for automatic failover. Also need to size autoscaling for p95.
pricebot: Rough committed estimate: 2xA100-equivalent reserved -> $YY,YYY/mo. I can refine after model size and batch profile.
leo_ae: I'll request artifact, tokenizer, 50 prompt samples, and a 60s trace from Marigold today.
kai_ml: With TorchScript we can run compile+kernel selection; if they only have ggml we'll run a quant profile. Custom GELU may add ~10% latency.
marta_security: I'll prepare NDA and security checklist; ask for vendor list and retention policies.
emily_sales: Timeline: artifacts today, Kai perf by Fri, Marta NDA asap, Nora to draft capacity quote, Pricebot to produce formal quote after perf.
deploy-bot: Create ticket INF-4790 to track Marigold POC onboarding steps.
